name: Commander Rayner
desc: Commander Rayner was an NPC at [Fort Merit](location:fort_merit) that requested your help, should they be shown an Officer's Note, with a situation at the Isle of Crows, and gave you the key to the basement. The Isle of Crows was an island that appeared in the Deepwoken direct.
additional_info: -   Bizarrely, despite being a member of [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority), they wore the Hive Adjudicator outfit.
